text: ok and then why does rig have a completely different painted face than the paint mode
resolution: Rig/object mode showed a different painted face than paint mode because paint mode sampled the RGBA <Paintable> while every other mode sampled the stale box-atlas StaticSurface (STUDIO_TEXTURE_KEY) — two different textures. Now a PAINTED model (has a paintRef, or inited this session) samples the paintable in ALL modes via a single modelPainted flag, and the box-atlas StaticSurface is no longer baked for a painted model. Same texture everywhere, so the face you painted shows identically in rig, object, and paint.
